snippet.title: My Little Cafe Nightmare - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares. Take over a crumbling, haunted café and transform it into a sanctuary for monstrous guests. Restore, decorate, and expand while brewing strange coffees, stocking supplies, and keeping hostile anomalies at bay.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726250/My_Little_Cafe_Nightmare/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
